name: scientific-research-plugin
description: A full-lifecycle research pipeline for OR & ML, 10 skills + 1 subagent take a project from prior-art survey to the conference talk — Zotero literature intake, structured reading notes, publication-grade figures, LaTeX polishing, noun-term jargon auditing, citation verification against official APIs, three-blind adversarial review, and point-by-point rebuttal. The survey-first discipline applies to any non-trivial task, not just papers.

interface.shortDescription: Every task is research: survey, fetch, read, plot, polish, review, rebut, present
